title: Helio G99
desc: Upper mid-range AP released in 2022, TSMC N6. Popular in budget-to-mid gaming phones, widely adopted by Xiaomi, Redmi, and Realme.

title: Dimensity 7300
desc: Midranger AP released in 2022, manufactured with TSMC N4 process.

title: Dimensity 8000
desc: AP released in 2022, TSMC N5. Binned down version of Dimensity 8100.

title: Dimensity 8100
desc: AP released in 2022, TSMC N5. Used in sub-flagship phones.

title: Dimensity 8200
desc: AP released in 2022, TSMC N4. D8100 ported to N4 with clock speed bump.

title: Dimensity 700
desc: Budget 5G SoC released in 2021, TSMC N7. Used in various budget 5G smartphones.

title: Exynos 1080
desc: Mid-range AP released in 2020, Samsung 5nm.

title: Exynos 1380
desc: Mid-range AP released in 2023, Samsung 5nm. Used in Galaxy A54/A55 and other mid-range phones.

title: Exynos 1480
desc: AP released in 2024, Samsung SF4. Used in higher end A/M/F series phones.

title: Exynos 1580
desc: AP released in 2025, Samsung SF4P. Used in higher end A/M/F series phones.

title: Exynos 2100
desc: Flagship AP released in 2021, Samsung 5nm. Used in Galaxy S21 series.

title: Exynos 2500
desc: Flagship AP, Samsung SF3. Features RDNA 3.5 based Xclipse GPU.

title: Exynos 990
desc: AP released in 2020, Samsung 8nm. Used in Galaxy S20 series.

title: Exynos 2600
desc: AP released in 2026 with a RDNA 4 based GPU, Samsung SF2. Used in Galaxy S26 series.

title: Tensor
desc: Google's first custom SoC, 2021, Samsung 5nm. Used in Pixel 6 series.

title: Tensor G2
desc: SoC released in 2022, Samsung 5nm. Used in Pixel 7 series.

title: Tensor G3
desc: SoC released in 2023, Samsung SF4P. Used in Pixel 8 series.

title: Tensor G5
desc: SoC released in 2025, TSMC N3P. Used in Pixel 10, Pixel 10 Pro, Pixel 10 Pro XL, Pixel 10 Pro Fold.

title: Snapdragon 855
desc: Flagship AP released in 2018, TSMC N7.

title: Snapdragon 8 Gen 1
desc: Flagship AP released in 2021, Samsung 4nm. Known for thermal issues.

title: Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1
desc: Flagship AP released in 2022, TSMC N4. Fixed the 8 Gen 1's thermal issues.

title: Snapdragon X Elite
desc: High-performance ARM PC processor, 2024, TSMC N4. Oryon custom cores for Windows on ARM laptops.

title: Snapdragon X2 Elite
desc: Second-gen Snapdragon X PC processor (Glymur), 2025, TSMC N3P. 12 Oryon-P + 6 Oryon-M cores with 16 + 16 + 12 MB L2, 9 MB SLC (6x 1.5 MB) and an Adreno X2-90 GPU.

title: Snapdragon 778G
desc: Upper mid-range AP, 2021, TSMC N5. Featured in Galaxy A52s 5G, Mi 11 Lite 5G NE, and others.

title: Snapdragon 780G
desc: Upper mid-range AP, 2021, SF5E, mini 888 or sort.

title: Snapdragon 7+ Gen 3 / 8s Gen 3
desc: Shared die between two SKUs, 2024, TSMC N4P. Same silicon, different clocks and branding for mid vs sub-flagship tiers.

title: Snapdragon 8 Elite
desc: Flagship AP, 2024, TSMC N3E. First Qualcomm chip with Oryon custom cores.

title: Snapdragon 7 Gen 3
desc: Mid-range AP released in 2023, TSMC N4.

title: Snapdragon 4 Gen 2/4
desc: Qualcomm Recycling Masterclass™. Samsung 4LPX.

title: Loongson 3A6000
desc: Quad-core desktop processor released in 2023, 12nm. Based on LoongArch (LA664).

title: XRing O3
desc: SoC released in 2026, TSMC N3P, 138.35 mm². 2x C1-Ultra + 4x C1-Premium + 4x C1-Pro, 16 MB L3 + 16 MB SLC, Mali G2-Ultra-NX MC16 and a quad-core NPU.

title: XRing O1
desc: SoC released in 2025, TSMC N3E. Used in Xiaomi 15S Pro, Pad 7 Ultra, Pad 7S Pro.

title: Pinecone Surge S1
desc: Mid-range SoC, 2017, TSMC 28nm HPC+. Xiaomi's first in-house chipset, featured in Mi 5c.

title: Kirin 980
desc: Flagship AP, 2018, TSMC N7. Used in Mate 20 series, P30 series, Honor 20 series...

title: Kirin 9000
desc: Flagship AP, 2020, TSMC N5. Used in Mate 40 Pro. Last Kirin on advanced TSMC nodes before sanctions.

title: Unisoc T820 / T9100
desc: Mid-range 5G SoC, 2022, TSMC N6. Featured in ZTE shitters and some handheld android consoles.

title: Apple A4
desc: Apple's first in-house SoC, 2010, Samsung 45nm. Single Cortex-A8 core, powered the original iPad and iPhone 4.

title: Apple A5 (APL7498)
desc: Special variant for Apple TV 3rd Gen. 32nm node, 1 CPU core and 2 GPU EUs removed vs original A5.

title: Apple A5
desc: Dual-core SoC released in 2011, Samsung 45nm. Powered iPhone 4S, iPad 2, and iPod touch 5th gen.

title: Apple A6
desc: Apple's first custom-designed CPU core (Swift). Released in 2012, Samsung 32nm. Powered iPhone 5.

title: Apple A7
desc: First 64-bit mobile SoC, 2013, Samsung 28nm. Dual-core Cyclone CPU, powered iPhone 5s with Touch ID.

title: Apple A8
desc: SoC released in 2014, TSMC 20nm. Dual-core Typhoon CPU, powered iPhone 6 and iPad mini 4.

title: Apple A9 (Samsung)
desc: Samsung 14nm variant of the A9. Dual-sourced with TSMC for iPhone 6s, notable for "chipgate" battery life controversy.

title: Apple A9 (TSMC)
desc: TSMC 16nm variant of the A9. Dual-sourced with Samsung for iPhone 6s, slightly better battery life in "chipgate" tests.

title: Apple A10 Fusion
desc: First quad-core Apple SoC famous for being a big or LITTLE SoC, 2016, TSMC 16nm. Powered iPhone 7 and iPad 6th/7th gen.

title: Apple A11 Bionic
desc: Apple's first SoC with a Neural Engine, released in 2017, TSMC 10nm. Powered iPhone 8 and the iconic iPhone X.

title: Apple A12 Bionic
desc: The industry's first mass-market 7nm SoC, 2018, TSMC N7. Powered iPhone XS, XR, and iPad Air 3rd Gen.

title: Apple A12X / A12Z Bionic
desc: High-performance tablet SoC, 2018/2020, TSMC N7. 8-core CPU + 7/8-core GPU. Powered iPad Pro 3rd/4th Gen and brief Mac transition via DTK.

title: Apple A13 Bionic
desc: Flagship SoC released in 2019, TSMC N7P. Powered iPhone 11 series and the 2nd generation iPhone SE.

title: Apple A14 Bionic
desc: The first commercially available 5nm chip, 2020, TSMC N5. Powered the iPhone 12 series and iPad Air 4th Gen.

title: Apple A15 Bionic
desc: Released in 2021, TSMC N5P. Featured in iPhone 13/14 series and iPad mini 6th Gen with specialized GPU variants.

title: Apple A16 Bionic
desc: Flagship SoC released in 2022, TSMC N4P. Powering the iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15 series.

title: Apple A17 Pro
desc: Flagship SoC released in 2023, TSMC N3B. First 3nm mobile chip, hardware ray tracing GPU. Powered iPhone 15 Pro series.

title: Apple A18 Pro
desc: Flagship SoC released in 2024, TSMC N3E. Enhanced Neural Engine for Apple Intelligence. Powered iPhone 16 Pro series.

title: Apple A19 Pro
desc: Flagship SoC released in 2025, TSMC N3P. The best. Undisputed (just ignore the GPU pls).

title: Apple M2
desc: Second-gen Apple Silicon, 2022, TSMC N5P. 8-core CPU + 10-core GPU, powered MacBook Air/Pro 13" and iPad Pro.

title: Apple M2 Pro
desc: Pro-tier Apple Silicon, 2023, TSMC N5P. Up to 12-core CPU + 19-core GPU, powered MacBook Pro 14"/16" and Mac mini.

title: Apple M3
desc: Third-gen Apple Silicon, 2023, TSMC N3B. 8-core CPU + 10-core GPU, powered MacBook Air 15" and iMac.

title: Apple M4
desc: Fourth-gen Apple Silicon, 2024, TSMC N3E. 10-core CPU + 10-core GPU, powered iPad Pro and MacBook Air.
